destaque.descricao: Turn your 3D model into photorealistic images in seconds, using your own project and without needing a powerful graphics card or complex software.

antesDepois.titulo: From raw model to photorealistic render.
antesDepois.descricao: Drag the ruler to compare. The same SketchUp scene, transformed by Lumi in seconds.
antesDepois.custoDescricao: No bundles, no hidden subscription. You connect your own API key and pay only for what you render — the cost is entirely in your control.

comoFunciona.titulo: From SketchUp to finished render in 4 steps.
comoFunciona.descricao: No file exporting, no manual lighting setup, no hours of waiting. You model in SketchUp — Lumi handles the rest with one click.

etapas.descricao: Set up the camera the way you always do. Lumi renders straight from SketchUp's active viewport — no exporting required.
Choose the scene type, the lighting mood, and the image ratio before you render.
The AI processes the scene in seconds. Render several views in sequence without repeating the process one by one.

etapas.titulo: Refine with AI if you want
etapas.descricao: Swap elements, adjust references, and use the post-processing sliders to get exactly the result you want.

funcionalidades.titulo: Everything you need to render with confidence.

itens.descricao: Photorealistic images generated in seconds from your model.
Lighting and reflections that respect materials and scene context.
Adjust fidelity to the model and the AI's creative level.
Pay once a year and use your own API key — no Lumi subscription, no middleman.
Pick the right resolution for each render, from a quick 2K preview to a final 4K delivery.
Everything inside SketchUp, with no learning curve.
New models and features released continuously.

galeria.titulo: Real renders made by Lumi users.

planos.subtitulo: The best AI rendering plugin, at the lowest price on the market. AI for everyone.
planos.descricao: You pay only for the plugin and connect your own API key — no Lumi subscription, no hidden markup.
planos.avisoIA: Powered by Google Gemini AI: top up your account from just $6 and keep creating without limits.

itens.citacao: Lumi cut my rendering time by 80%. I present renders in the same meeting where I design the project.
Finally a render inside SketchUp that looks real. My clients love the level of realism.
The combination of AI plus manual controls is brilliant. I get model fidelity when I want it and creative freedom when I need it.

perguntasFrequentes.textoAjuda: Can't find your answer? Reach us at

itens.resposta: No. Lumi uses cloud processing to generate AI renders, so an internet connection is required during use.

itens.pergunta: Do I need a powerful graphics card?
itens.resposta: No. All the heavy processing happens on our servers. Your computer just needs to run SketchUp normally.

itens.pergunta: Can I use it for commercial projects?
itens.resposta: Yes. All Lumi licenses, including the monthly plan, allow unlimited use in commercial and client projects.
The macOS version is in development and coming soon. Lumi is currently available for Windows only.
We offer a 7-day guarantee on all plans. If Lumi doesn't meet your expectations, we refund 100% of the amount paid.
